build_BaseStrategyModelV2: build a transformer-based Diplomacy AI strategy model with configurable encoder and policy decoder
build_BaseStrategyModel: build a GNN-based Diplomacy AI strategy model with graph convolution encoder and LSTM decoder
run_BaseStrategyModelV2_forward: run a forward pass through BaseStrategyModelV2 to sample orders and estimate power shares
run_TransformerEncoder: run the transformer encoder to encode board state, power, and global inputs into embeddings
run_ValueDecoder: run the value decoder to estimate sum-of-squares power shares from encoded board representations
review_LSTMBaseStrategyModelDecoder: review the LSTM decoder that autoregressively samples Diplomacy orders using attention and candidate embeddings
review_BaseStrategyModelEncoder: review the GNN encoder that processes board state and previous orders through graph convolution blocks
run_compute_order_features: run compute_order_features to generate one-hot feature vectors for the Diplomacy order vocabulary
run_apply_permute_powers: run power permutation data augmentation to randomly shuffle the 7 Diplomacy powers in a batch
run_GraphConv: run a graph convolution layer that computes A times x times W plus bias for board state features
